scope: Independent pre-inference review of every question, complete evidence record and rubric; reviewer did not author the dataset or run generator inference.

checks.reference_answers_fit_192_output_tokens: All compact answer JSON references are at most 151 UTF-8 bytes; the independently inspected common installed byte-BPE bound establishes that a compliant concise reference plus two conservative terminal slots fits below 192 tokens.
checks.primary_schedule: six paired blocks, twenty requests per model block, five per category; every request once per model

findings.issue: Rubric required a gap-free schedule although the initial question specified only order and no overlap.
findings.correction: Question now explicitly requires back-to-back chores with no gaps.

findings.issue: The phrase pack count could mean the known number of packs.
findings.correction: Question now refers explicitly to the number of tiles per pack.

findings.issue: Two storage locations could theoretically be nested rather than conflicting.
findings.correction: Evidence now establishes separate nonnested storage places.

findings.issue: Two named returners could jointly return the stool, which would not establish the rubric-required conflict.
findings.correction: Each record now asserts an exclusive sole returner and excludes the other person.

findings.issue: Initial question did not explicitly ask the before-programme margin required by the rubric.
findings.correction: Question now asks how long before the programme the visit finished.

findings.issue: Initial question referred to one unchanged part while the rubric requires time and place.
findings.correction: Question now asks which parts stayed the same.

findings.issue: Initial question asked duration but rubric also required the exact overlap interval.
findings.correction: Question now explicitly asks both overlap interval and duration.

findings.issue: The workload is assistant-authored and balanced by design. Familiar general concepts and common synthetic uncertainty templates do not establish household frequency, absence from pretraining, or independent human validity.
findings.correction: Keep these limitations in reporting; human validation remains pending.
